risk_items.finding: Reader redirection and cross-file reader impact analysis is too ambiguous for Codex alone.
risk_items.evidence: Multiple downstream readers across different modules and languages are affected; the exact cutover sequence requires exploratory reasoning.
risk_items.why_it_matters: Codex is best for bounded implementation tasks with deterministic verification. The redirection orchestration needs broader reasoning.
risk_items.recommended_constraint: Route reader-redirection orchestration to Claude or human; keep Codex for bounded DDL/DML and test files.
risk_items.required_verification: Manual review of the redirection plan before execution.

blind_spots: Whether any readers are outside the current repo.
questions: Is there a central registry of ohlcv consumers?
recommended_task_graph_constraints: Reader redirection tasks must be marked implementation_agent: claude or human.
